title: Endocrine system
audience: a medical student in the preclinical years
purpose: Integrate hormone principles and the hypothalamic–pituitary axis, pituitary, thyroid, adrenal and parathyroid physiology and disease, calcium and bone, the endocrine pancreas, diabetes and its emergencies, endocrine tumors and endocrine drugs.

weeks.1: Hormone principles and the hypothalamic–pituitary axis

blocks.deliverable: Interpret paired hormone levels in pituitary disease.
Choose the right test for Cushing syndrome and adrenal insufficiency.
Manage diabetic ketoacidosis step by step.
Compare diabetes drug classes by mechanism and risk.
Submit the project; take an unseen 150 minute final in week 14.

project: Endocrine lab interpretation: work up six supplied cases using hormone pairs and suppression or stimulation tests.
completion: finish the project, take the week 7 midterm and week 14 cumulative final, then complete a new cumulative assessment after 1 to 2 weeks. Explain one major idea aloud without notes.
